metadata.day_based_split_note: CICIDS2017 flow CSV does not carry reliable per-flow timestamps after deduplication and concatenation; a day-based (Mon-Wed train / Thu-Fri test) split cannot be performed without access to the raw per-day CSVs. The stratified random split is therefore the only one executed. Results are likely optimistic relative to a true temporal split because flows from the same day appear in both train and test. This is noted as a limitation.

split_method: Deduplication (330,959 exact duplicates removed from 2,830,743 raw rows) prior to split; stratified 80/20 train/test partition. Scaler and encoder fit strictly on training set. WARNING: stratified random split — results likely optimistic; see day_based_split_note.
model_architecture: XGBoost multi-class classifier (n_estimators=300, max_depth=8, lr=0.08, subsample=0.85, colsample=0.85)

with_destination_port.note: Includes Destination Port feature. Higher raw metric but risks overfitting to specific port numbers in synthetic benchmark captures.

without_destination_port.note: Port-agnostic feature space (flow rates, packet lengths, TCP window, inter-arrival times). Demonstrates resilience against non-standard port shifting.

known_dataset_limitations_note: CICIDS2017 has documented labeling errors and duplicated records (Engelen et al., 2021). All results reflect cleaned deduplicated subsets. Day-based split not performed (see metadata.day_based_split_note).
confusion_matrix_note: Full confusion matrix available in ai_engine/models/confusion_matrix.npy if generated during training.
